specification: RESTAURANT UI DESIGN SYSTEM — STRICT RULES (user attachment)

criteria.result: Task-oriented existing workflows retained; simplified login and account navigation; no invented restaurant data or decorative KPIs.
All nine requested palette tokens centralized. Teal is the shared accent; semantic states include text. 28 foreground/background and control-boundary contrast pairs pass.

Shared 4px spacing scale, management desktop padding 24–32px, mobile 16px, cards 16–24px, form field gap 16px, label gap 8px. Fixed image sizes, safe-area offsets and printer geometry remain component constraints.

Locally bundled Vietnamese Inter; common page/section/card/body/secondary/caption/KPI scale is 24/18/16/14/13/12/28px. Amounts use tabular numbers. Kitchen ticket uses 16px name, 14px details and 28px quantity.
Existing shell and module templates retained. Shared management cards/tables reused; tablet/mobile content reflows. Grid track counts adapt to each workflow rather than forcing one density.

Primary/secondary/ghost/destructive controls and 32/40/48/56px sizes. Corrected 44px action buttons to 48px, including POS; inputs and sidebar retain their separately specified sizes. Hover/focus/disabled/loading and payment-retry behavior checked.
Common white cards, 1px divider border, 12px radius, no default card shadow. Removed redundant kitchen workspace card. Semantic alerts and overlays remain functional.

Shared desktop table header 44px; operational rows 52–56px; 12px vertical and 16px horizontal padding. Separators drawn inside rows. Numbers align right; identifiers left. Shared mobile tables become labeled lists; mobile list padding is 8px vertically.
Single-column forms preferred, 40–44px inputs, 8px radius, visible labels above search/filter fields. Validation, empty/error/retry and modal confirmation workflows retained.
240px management sidebar, 44px navigation items, 20px icons, teal-soft active state. Mobile navigation collapses; account actions use progressive disclosure.
25 UI contexts across widths 320/390/768/1024/1440 have no document overflow or JavaScript errors. Mobile customer cart keeps count/total/action visible.

POS preserves item selection, quantities, totals and checkout. Dashboard keeps actionable exceptions. Kitchen shows dish, quantity, table, elapsed receipt time and the existing 60-minute long-wait warning. Customer menu keeps imagery, names, prices, availability and add actions. No shift/availability data is invented where the backend has no such workflow.

Keyboard login/navigation, native dialog Escape, visible focus, disabled states, error recovery and reduced motion checked. Destructive operations retain confirmations; backup regression covers MFA/CONFIRM and restore monitoring.
Shared tokens/components reused with explicit ownership; visual review and automated regression cover all three applications.

coverageLimits: Browser mutations use isolated API fixtures. No orders, payments, backup restores or customer records are changed in production.
Contrast checks and keyboard scenarios are targeted verification, not an independent complete WCAG audit of every screen/state.
Existing receipt printing keeps thermal-printer typography and millimeter constraints.
Production checks must confirm the deployed commit, actual JavaScript/CSS assets, HTTPS/CORS and the same UI scenarios against deployed bundles.
